data.title: Grant Cardone Says Commercial Real Estate Faces Historic Crash - Sees Bitcoin As A 'Complementary Asset'
data.description: Real estate investor Grant Cardone said 5-year borrowing costs are 6.4%, pressuring property values as $1 trillion in commercial loans mature in six months.
data.keywords: Grant Cardone, Cardone Capital, commercial real estate, commercial loans, Bitcoin, real estate
